title: [Master] Bug 650348: [Expense Agent] Closed travel requests are editable and are missing approver info.
summary: Travel request cards now prevent editing closed requests, record approver information for auto-approved requests, and display the requested-for user name.
key_points: Closed travel requests become read-only to prevent accidental modifications
Automatic approval now captures the approving user and timestamp
Travel request card displays the expense user name of who requested it
quote: Restrict editable Travel Request fields to open requests.
